on 19 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
on 19 - every one of his remaining 3 holes is now appointment viewing
4 more points and the problem becomes Johnson's problem
Johnson is one good hole of his away from inheriting the lead nobody wants
in on 1 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
1 point from infamy - every 1-pointer counts double now
his lead over Johnson is 1 - a strong gust could move it
one bad hole from a Johnson reunion at the bottom
2 clear with 2 to play - points only go up, but so does the tension
